rules.rationale: The A13 Android.mk-only xmllint target is represented in Android 16 by converting the maintained Soong xmllint module from host-only to host-supported target binary. Current libxml2 sources do not require the old sys/timeb compatibility workaround.
rules.necessity: Required by guest data-recovery XML inspection tooling.
rules.performance: Adds a 101320-byte utility to system/bin and no resident process or boot-time work.
rules.security: Uses current libxml2 source and build flags instead of reviving an old makefile and compatibility macro; exposure is limited to the command-line binary already selected by product packaging.
validation_evidence: Target output /system/bin/xmllint exists and has SHA-256 c942dcbfdd7481618589f9086af2fe616e0ae463690c8beecdc17930cfe65577. Component branch aosp16-bst-merge is clean; functional recovery invocation remains pending.
